_about: Every credential the unattended runs depend on, and when it stops working (Stage 83 item 6). Each entry needs a name, where it is kept, what breaks without it, and an expires date (YYYY-MM-DD). src/core/credentials.py reads this file; the nightly dependency audit runs it every Monday and opens an issue 30 days before any expires date. Where the real date is not recorded, expires is an estimate and expires_basis says how it was worked out and which way it could be wrong. Every secrets.NAME a workflow reads, other than GitHub's own GITHUB_TOKEN, must be listed here (tests/test_credentials.py).

credentials.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
credentials.used_by: Booth (booth-pr-audit.yml, booth-regression.yml), Spotter (spotter.yml) and Line Judge (line-judge-diagnose.yml, and the judge jobs in nba-daily.yml, nhl-daily.yml, nfl-weekly-update.yml and nfl-weekend-refresh.yml)
credentials.breaks: Every agent run fails at its model step: no Booth audit, so no pull request can meet the merge rule.
credentials.expires_basis: Not recorded. The secret is first read on 2026-09-05 (ea08b1e3 creates booth-pr-audit.yml), and a token from claude setup-token is assumed to last one year from the day it was made. If it was made a few days before that commit, it expires a few days earlier than this date, inside the 30-day warning; if it has been replaced since, later. Mark: replace this with the token's own date.
credentials.renew: Run claude setup-token, then replace the repository secret (Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions).

credentials.name: cron-job.org GitHub token
credentials.kept_in: cron-job.org, in each job's request header; not in this repository
credentials.breaks: Scheduled runs start only from GitHub's own cron, hours late, and every covered slot opens a missed-dispatch issue (src/core/missed_dispatch.py).
credentials.expires_basis: Made on 2026-10-04 as a fine-grained token for this repository, Actions read and write, expiring after one year (memory/2026-10-04.md, docs/decisions/0005-cron-job-org.md). GitHub shows the exact date on the token's page.
credentials.renew: Make a new fine-grained token with the same scope, then paste it into every cron-job.org job's Authorization header.
